about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply:
You were matched because you both share interests in live music and gigs, and you like similar weekends like going to the cinema. 

You're also both looking for a laid-back mentor.

how often.reply:
You asked to meet with your mentor every two weeks. 
You can find their details and how to get in touch on the Your Mentor page.

checklist.reply: You still need to join a society and find a dentist, which you can do using the GP and Dentist Finder.

who is my mentor.reply: You can find your mentor's name and how to get in touch on the Your Mentor page.

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply: Since you are studying English Literature, you might like the [[English]] society. Have you had a chance to look at it yet?

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply:
The mentoring coordinator is matching students by hand, so your mentor is still being found. 

Once your match is ready, you can check the Your Mentor page to see why you were paired and how to get in touch.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply:
You haven't been matched with a mentor yet, but you can easily sign up on the Your Mentor page.
Would you like to take a look at how that works?
